snippet.title: The Relic: First Guardian - 'A New Fate' Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The Relic: First Guardian launches May 26th 2026 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Steam!

https://linktr.ee/perpgames

In this action RPG, you embark on a heroic adventure to save the world.

The once-prosperous Arsiltus was swallowed up by the void created by the destruction of the great relic and transformed into a land of death. Now your mission is to find the pieces of the broken great relic and close the void.

Grow your character with various skills, solve the riddle of Arsiltus, and lead the world back to prosperity.

You are the last hope of the Arsiltus.
